scope: Actual disposable SQLite stores, authored sync payloads, existing VACUUM restore; zero providers, no public deployment

checks.name: Shared database coordinates per-account concurrency across two independent stores
Global three-request concurrency is transactional across accounts and stores
Quota attempts are not refunded by errors or lease release and survive reopening
UTC rollover resets attempt windows while live leases remain bounded
Abandoned leases expire and revoked session versions cannot acquire a lease
First sync has an account-specific epoch and no fabricated data
Canonical ownership and compare-and-swap reject stale or foreign writes
Lost-ACK retry is idempotent and cannot rewrite a newer revision
Sync strips binaries, live timers, unknown fields and rejects oversized input
Three-way merge keeps independent edits and detects same-item conflicts
Delete-versus-edit is a conflict; unchanged items can be deleted safely
Deleting server data invalidates the old epoch and cannot resurrect an old outbox
Seven-day expiry removes payload and generates a fresh sync epoch
VACUUM backup and restore preserve schema, canonical accounts and sync state
Older direct PUT preserves unsupported V8 controls while applying opt-out preferences
Explicit controls clear is retained and replaying an older intent never resurrects it
Combined preserved payload enforces size cap with no snapshot or receipt mutation
